description: This file defines the ConnectionStateListener interface, which includes callbacks for connection events and a default VOID instance implementing the interface with empty methods.

classes.name: ConnectionStateListener
classes.description: An interface for handling connection state events, including methods for when the connection is established or fails, and a default VOID implementation.

methods.name: onConnectionEstablished
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection and configuration from the controller are established.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection attempt fails.
